title: 3 Terrifying Space Facts That Keep Scientists Awake
hook: There are rogue planets hurtling through pitch-black space right now with no star.

scenes.text: There are rogue planets hurtling through pitch-black space right now with no star.

scenes.text: Billions of these celestial phantoms drift freely, completely undetected until they enter a solar system.
scenes.visual_prompt: vast majestic galaxy spiral with ominous dark nebulae, cosmic dust clouds, deep space photography 8k vertical wallpaper

scenes.text: Even stranger, the Boötes Void is a 330 million light-year expanse of almost complete emptiness.

scenes.text: Scientists still cannot explain why such a massive region of the universe has virtually no galaxies.
scenes.visual_prompt: futuristic astronaut looking out of spacecraft window into deep dark cosmos, visor reflection of stars, cinematic 8k vertical

scenes.text: If humanity disappeared tomorrow, the universe would not even blink. Which cosmic secret scares you the most?
